description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerAttributeService, providing methods to manage CustomerAttribute entities including save, update, delete, and retrieval functions. It relies on a DAO layer and extends a generic service implementation.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerAttributeService providing CRUD operations and retrieval methods for CustomerAttribute entities.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerAttribute after retrieving it by ID to ensure it is attached.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on store, customer ID, and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all CustomerAttributes for a given customer in a specific store.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by store and option ID.
